line: Crowley's Three of Swords is the card for the second decan of Libra, with Saturn as its planet in the sign.

sections.title: Crowley's card for this decan
sections.line: Crowley's chapter gives the title and the planet in Libra.

quotes.quote: manifests itself in the Three of Swords, the Lord of Sorrow
This is accentuated by the Celestial Lordship of Saturn in Libra.

sections.title: What the card is, in his words
sections.line: His description of what the card figures, as the card chapter gives it.

quotes.quote: This card is dark and heavy; it is, so to speak, the womb of Chaos.
